name: Trust/IOLTA Balance Alerts

parameters.content:
## Trust/IOLTA Balance Alerts

### How it works

1. Runs daily. Pulls every open matter's trust balance from Clio.
2. Tiers each matter: negative (a serious compliance event), low (below your configured replenishment threshold), or healthy.
3. Alerts the firm's trust accounting contact for anything negative or low -- once per tier change or after a cooldown, not every single day for the same unresolved balance.
4. A negative balance ALSO immediately escalates to the managing partner, regardless of cooldown -- this is the one alert that should never wait.
5. Separately, a weekly rollup reports every open matter's trust balance (not just alert-worthy ones), for accounting's own review.

**This only ever reports and alerts on balances already recorded in Clio -- it never moves money, adjusts a ledger, or makes any accounting decision.** Nothing here touches legal work (ABA Op. 512); it's operational balance monitoring only.

### Before you start: confirm the trust_balance field for your Clio setup

This assumes `trust_balance` is a valid requestable field on Clio's Matters endpoint. Confirm this live before deploying -- if your Clio API version or plan doesn't expose it this way, the fallback is aggregating `/trust_line_items.json` per matter yourself (summing debits/credits), which isn't built here since the exact ledger structure varies by how each firm's trust accounts are configured in Clio.

### Setup steps

- [ ] Set up the Bar-Compliance Guardrail (NTC-33) first -- this template inherits OPS1 per its ticket, even though every recipient is firm staff, not a client.
- [ ] Configure a Clio OAuth2 credential (reuse if already deployed).
- [ ] Set the required n8n Variables: CLIO_BASE_URL, FIRM_NAME, FIRM_TRUST_ACCOUNTING_EMAIL, FIRM_PARTNER_EMAIL, GUARDRAIL_WORKFLOW_ID.
- [ ] Optionally tune LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD and ALERT_COOLDOWN_DAYS.
- [ ] Activate the workflow.

### Customization

LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD is the entire tiering surface for the 'low balance' warning -- edit that n8n Variable, not the code. A negative balance is always its own tier regardless of this setting.

## Check balances, tier, and alert

Pulls every open matter's trust balance, tiers it, and alerts on anything negative or low -- with a cooldown so the same unresolved balance doesn't re-alert every single day.

## Immediate partner escalation for negative balances

A negative trust balance is a serious compliance event -- this branch always fires regardless of the cooldown above.

## Weekly trust health rollup — a second, independent branch

Reports every open matter's trust balance, not just the alert-worthy ones, for accounting's own periodic review.

nodes.name: Check Trust Balances Daily
nodes.notes: Runs daily, 7am by default.

nodes.name: Fetch Open Matters With Trust Balance
nodes.notes: Requests trust_balance directly on the Matters endpoint -- confirm this field name against your Clio API version before relying on it live (see the workflow doc sticky).

nodes.name: Split Matter Records
nodes.notes: Clio wraps list responses in a 'data' array — this unwraps it so downstream nodes get one matter per item.

nodes.name: Compute Trust Balance Alert Tier
nodes.notes: LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD and ALERT_COOLDOWN_DAYS control tiering and re-alert frequency -- a matter that worsens from low to negative always alerts immediately regardless of cooldown.

nodes.name: Filter To Alert-Worthy Matters
nodes.notes: Reads from its own input directly (not by name) -- unlike this catalog's digest templates, each surviving item here is emailed individually, not aggregated into one summary, so there's no downstream node that needs to always run regardless of count.

nodes.name: Build Trust Balance Alert Email
nodes.notes: One email per alert-worthy matter, with the full balance and matter detail.

nodes.name: Check Compliance Before Trust Alert
nodes.notes: This template inherits OPS1 per its ticket, even though every recipient is firm staff, not a client -- the opt-out/disclaimer checks are effectively inert here, but the audit log entry is still valuable for a compliance-grade template like this one.

nodes.name: If Trust Alert Approved
nodes.notes: Mirrors the guardrail's approved/opted-out result.

nodes.name: Send Trust Balance Alert Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Trust Balance Alert Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip — Recipient Opted Out
nodes.notes: Rare for an internal accounting recipient, but respected the same as any other opt-out check in this catalog.

nodes.name: If Balance Is Negative
nodes.notes: Only a negative balance triggers immediate partner escalation -- a low (but still positive) balance only goes to the accounting alert above.

nodes.name: Build Partner Escalation Email
nodes.notes: Escalates directly to the managing partner -- a negative trust balance never waits for the accounting alert's cooldown logic.

nodes.name: Log Partner Escalation For Audit
nodes.notes: Fire-and-forget audit logging -- this goes to the firm's own managing partner, so the guardrail's approval result is deliberately ignored, same internal-notification pattern used elsewhere in this catalog.

nodes.name: Send Partner Escalation Email
nodes.notes: Reaches back to 'Build Partner Escalation Email' by name, not $json, since the guardrail call in between replaces $json with its own response.

nodes.name: Skip Partner Escalation
nodes.notes: Not a negative balance -- no partner escalation needed, the accounting alert above already covers a low balance.

nodes.name: Check Weekly Trust Health Rollup
nodes.notes: Runs weekly, Monday 8am by default.

nodes.name: Fetch All Matters For Trust Rollup
nodes.notes: Same Matters endpoint as the daily check, but every open matter regardless of balance tier.

nodes.name: Compute Weekly Trust Health Summary
nodes.notes: LOW_BALANCE_THRESHOLD matches the daily check's tiering — same threshold used for consistency.

nodes.name: Build Weekly Trust Health Email
nodes.notes: Internal accounting summary — no guardrail wrap needed, matching this catalog's other weekly rollups.

nodes.name: Send Weekly Trust Health Email
nodes.notes: Internal, firm-wide summary — no guardrail wrap needed.

A negative balance also immediately escalates to the managing partner. Separately, a weekly rollup reports every open matter's balance for accounting's own review.
